activities.name: ST
activities.whenToUse: Use to forward the plan to the registered Conduction.ST adapter; downstream plan requirements still apply even though this activity declares no local input properties. A failed delegate can be invoked a second time.
resultNotes: Successful mapped ST invocation has no public Result: MappedConductionAdapter drops the delegated result.
A failed delegate yields a failed Signal with no Result; ConductionCondenser.ST can invoke that delegate twice.

activities.name: Sleep
activities.whenToUse: Use for a synchronous delay of Config.Duration seconds. The result reports measured duration and a tolerance match; Matched can be false even when the Signal succeeds.
activities.description: Pause for Config.Duration seconds and return ActualDuration (measured seconds) and Matched (absolute difference <= 0.1 seconds, inclusive). Scheduling delay can yield Matched=false without an adapter failure.

properties.description: Required finite, nonnegative number of seconds; zero is permitted.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a finite, nonnegative numeric value in seconds when using Sleep; zero is allowed. Numeric strings and Booleans are rejected.

result.description: True when the absolute difference between ActualDuration and requested Duration is at most 0.1 seconds.

resultNotes: Matched=false can accompany a successful Signal; it is a timing-domain mismatch.
Missing or invalid Duration, or a Start-Sleep exception, fails the Signal without Result.
